label: Authored aggregate interval tape for Flow Circuit. Not a production event history.

dataDictionary.atSeconds: Observation times. The preceding observed sample is held until the next sample; individual timings are unavailable.
dataDictionary.retryRates: Measured offered retry attempts/second at each observation, with one first attempt per root.
dataDictionary.etlQueued: Queue stock under the declared initially empty, constant-rate, complete no-loss ETL ledger.
dataDictionary.retryModel: Conditional outcome model; 80% first-attempt success and 50% success on each allowed retry. This does not measure the observed incident's outcomes.
